subject: Request: sample Art.30 ledger + subprocessor custody & retention matrix
messages:
From: Sasha Ivanov <sasha.ivanov@meditrust.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@meditrust.com
Date: 2026-09-11T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: Sample ledger + retention details for upcoming audit

Hi Vanessa,

We’re preparing the EU data protection readiness pack ahead of a scheduled audit window (late September). As part of the kickoff the auditor asked for a short sample export of your Article 30 processing activities ledger and a retention matrix tied to any subprocessor transfers. Specifically they want:

- An excerpt of Article 30 ledger rows covering 10 recent customer transfers (fields: processing purpose, categories of data, subprocessor name, recipients, transfer mechanism, retention period).
- A simple retention matrix that maps record type -> default retention period -> legal basis -> deletion/archival path.
- Any custody logs or access records showing subprocessor access for at least two of the subprocessors listed in the DPA (time-limited, redacted IDs are fine).

Can you confirm if these can be delivered by EOD Tuesday (2026-09-14)? We can accept redacted outputs if needed for customer confidentiality. If there are any constraints (SLA, export format, CSV/Excel), please flag now.

Thanks — Sasha
Sasha Ivanov
Privacy Officer, MediTrust Health

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
To: Sasha Ivanov <sasha.ivanov@meditrust.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-09-11T11:03:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Sample ledger + retention details for upcoming audit

Hi Sasha — thanks for the clear list. We can provide a redacted Article 30 excerpt and retention matrix. A couple quick clarifications so we scope correctly:

- For the Article 30 rows, do you want transfers that involve international cross-border mechanisms (SCCs/Onshore) only, or a mix including internal subprocessors?
- For custody/access logs: are time-of-access + role sufficient, or do you need specific resource identifiers (we can redact PII but need to know the fields).
- Preferred file formats? We can give CSV for ledger and XLSX for the retention matrix.

I’ll coordinate the export and have our privacy pack assembled by EOD Tue if there are no unusual requests. Looping in Lauren and Karthik to confirm redaction approach and legal acceptability.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Trust & Compliance (Operations)
Redwood Inference

From: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com, Sasha Ivanov <sasha.ivanov@meditrust.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-09-11T12:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Sample ledger + retention details for upcoming audit

Quick note from legal/privacy side:

- Provide a mixed sample (include at least 3 cross-border transfers and 7 other ledger rows) so the auditor sees both SCC and onshore-handled examples.
- Custody logs: time-of-access + internal role + subprocessor name is sufficient. No request for down-to-resource IDs or end-user PII.
- Redaction: replace any customer identifiers with a stable hashed token (e.g., CUST-xxxx) so rows can be correlated but not attributable.
- Include a short cover memo that explains redaction, the query used to produce the extract, and the retention default (source: retention policy v2).

I’ll sign off on the cover memo. Vanessa, please ensure we attach the DPIA notes summary (we’ll redact any internal reviewer comments).

— Lauren
Senior Privacy Counsel

From: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com, lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-09-13T09:18:00-04:00
Subject: Internal: extraction plan + attachments (for Vanessa)

Vanessa — I ran the export in the Console staging workspace and prepared initial artifacts. Attaching the three files we discussed:

1) redwood_art30_ledger_excerpt.csv — 10 rows, fields: date, processing_purpose, data_categories, subprocessor, recipient_country, transfer_mechanism, retention_days, customer_token
2) retention_matrix_v1.xlsx — 4 worksheets: personal_data, logs, backups, telemetry with mappings and retention rationale
3) dpia_notes_202609.pdf — redacted DPIA summary (internal reviewer initials removed)

Notes:
- Custody/access log snapshot cannot include raw IPs; exported with columns [timestamp, actor_role, subprocessor_name, action]. Two subprocessors are included as samples: "CloudCache Ltd" and "EdgeServe GmbH".
- I added a one-paragraph cover note inside retention_matrix describing query filters and the date range (last 90 days).

If that looks good to you and Lauren we can package and upload to the Drive folder and share the link to Sasha.

— Marissa
Customer Success (Privacy Integrations)

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
To: Sasha Ivanov <sasha.ivanov@meditrust.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, procurement@meditrust.com
Date: 2026-09-14T14:42:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Sample ledger + retention details for upcoming audit

Hi Sasha — attaching the requested redacted artifacts and a short cover memo. Summary below and link above.

Attachments included: redwood_art30_ledger_excerpt.csv (redacted), retention_matrix_v1.xlsx (with cover note), dpia_notes_202609.pdf (redacted summary).

Key points:
- 10 ledger rows exported (mixed: 3 cross-border with SCCs, 7 onshore/local). Customer identifiers replaced with stable tokens (CUST-####).
- Custody log snapshot includes [timestamp, actor_role, subprocessor_name, action]; raw IPs and resource IDs removed.
- Retention matrix maps record classes to retention_days and legal_basis; see sheet "Backups" for archival exception notes.
- Covered by our DPA: transfer mechanisms and subprocessors are documented; please let us know if the auditor needs a different date range or more rows.

Drive link (read-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwoodAuditSamples
JIRA ticket for the package: JIRA-PRIV-8421

If the auditor would like a short walkthrough call (15-20m) to confirm redaction approach, I can schedule one this week.

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Trust & Compliance (Operations)
Redwood Inference
